rules.name: EMA 9/21 Cross
rules.summary: Long while the 9 EMA is above the 21 EMA.

rules.name: EMA 9/21 Long & Short
rules.summary: Always in the market, on the side of the 9/21 EMA cross.

rules.name: EMA 20/50 Cross
rules.summary: A slower cross that sits out more of the chop.

rules.name: Golden Cross
rules.summary: Long while the 50 SMA is above the 200 SMA.

rules.name: SMA 20/50 Cross
rules.summary: The classic moving-average cross on simple averages.

rules.name: Price Above SMA 50
rules.summary: Long while price closes above the 50-day average.

rules.name: Price Above SMA 200
rules.summary: The simplest trend filter there is: above the 200-day average or in cash.

rules.name: EMA Ribbon 8/21/50
rules.summary: Long only while three averages are stacked in order.

rules.name: Hull Trend
rules.summary: Long while the Hull moving average is rising.

rules.name: MACD Cross
rules.summary: Long from the MACD crossing its signal line until it crosses back.

rules.name: MACD Zero Line
rules.summary: Long while MACD is above zero, a slower read of the same idea.

rules.name: Supertrend 10/3
rules.summary: Long while Supertrend is green.

rules.name: Supertrend Long & Short
rules.summary: Always in the market, on the side Supertrend shows.

rules.name: Supertrend 20/5
rules.summary: A wide Supertrend that aims to hold the big moves.

rules.name: ADX Trend Filter
rules.summary: An EMA trend, taken only when ADX says a trend exists.

rules.name: DI Cross
rules.summary: Long while +DI leads -DI.

rules.name: Momentum 10
rules.summary: Long while price is above where it was ten bars ago.

rules.name: Momentum 90
rules.summary: Absolute momentum: long while the last three months are positive.

rules.name: Trend + MACD
rules.summary: MACD entries, allowed only above the 200 SMA.

rules.name: OBV Trend
rules.summary: Long while On-Balance Volume is above its own average.

rules.name: Donchian Breakout 20
rules.summary: Buy a new 20-bar high, sell a new 10-bar low.

rules.name: Donchian 55 (Turtle)
rules.summary: The Turtle system: a 55-day high in, a 20-day low out.

rules.name: Donchian Long & Short
rules.summary: Goes with whichever side breaks a 20-bar range.

rules.name: Bollinger Breakout
rules.summary: Buy a close above the upper band, exit at the mid-line.

rules.name: Keltner Breakout
rules.summary: Buy a close above the Keltner channel, exit at its mid-line.

rules.name: Volume Breakout
rules.summary: A 20-bar high on twice the normal volume.

rules.name: Breakout With 3R Target
rules.summary: A 20-bar high with a 2 ATR stop and a target three times the risk.

rules.name: Breakout With ATR Trail
rules.summary: A 20-bar high, then a 3 ATR trailing stop rides the move.

rules.name: Squeeze Breakout
rules.summary: Bollinger bands inside Keltner, then the first close above the band.

rules.name: Dip or Breakout
rules.summary: Takes whichever comes first: an RSI dip or a 20-day high.

rules.name: RSI Reversion 30/70
rules.summary: Buy RSI under 30, sell over 70.

rules.name: RSI-2 Scalp
rules.summary: Buy a two-period RSI under 10, sell over 60.

rules.name: RSI-2 With Trend Filter
rules.summary: The same dip, bought only above the 200 SMA.

rules.name: RSI Fade Short
rules.summary: Short RSI over 75, cover under 50.

rules.name: Stochastic 20/80
rules.summary: Buy the stochastic under 20, sell over 80.

rules.name: Bollinger Dip
rules.summary: Buy a close under the lower band, exit at the mid-line.

rules.name: Bollinger Fade Long & Short
rules.summary: Fades both bands back to the mid-line.

rules.name: Stretch Below SMA 20
rules.summary: Buy 2% below the 20 SMA, sell back at it.

rules.name: CCI Reversion
rules.summary: Buy CCI crossing back above -100, sell over +100.

rules.name: Money Flow Reversion
rules.summary: Buy the Money Flow Index under 20, sell over 80.

rules.name: Z-Score Reversion
rules.summary: Buy two standard deviations under the mean, sell back at it.

rules.name: Three Down Closes
rules.summary: Buy after three lower closes in a row, hold five bars.

rules.name: Close Near The Low
rules.summary: Buy a close in the bottom fifth of the bar, in an uptrend.

rules.name: Volume Climax Reversal
rules.summary: Buy a heavy down bar on three times the volume, hold five bars.

rules.name: Range High Fade
rules.summary: Short a 60-bar high with RSI stretched: 3 ATR stop, 2R target, 48 bars at most.

rules.name: EMA 21 Pullback
rules.summary: In an uptrend, buy the dip to the 21 EMA: 1.5 ATR stop, 3R target.

rules.name: RSI Pullback
rules.summary: In an uptrend, buy RSI under 40 and sell over 60.

rules.name: Dip Above SMA 200
rules.summary: A five-period RSI under 30, above the 200 SMA.

rules.name: Trend Pullback 1%
rules.summary: In an uptrend, buy a 1% dip under the 20 EMA.

rules.name: Short The Rally
rules.summary: In a downtrend, short the bounce to the 21 EMA: 1.5 ATR stop, 3R target.

rules.name: Bracket Trend
rules.summary: A trend entry with a fixed +6% target and -3% stop.

rules.name: Bracket RSI
rules.summary: An RSI dip with a fixed +4% target and -2% stop.

rules.name: Trailing Stop Trend
rules.summary: A 20/50 trend entry; a 3 ATR trail decides the exit.

rules.name: Protective Stop
rules.summary: A 20/50 cross with a 5% hard stop behind it.

rules.name: Chandelier Exit
rules.summary: Above the 200 SMA, held until a 4 ATR trail is hit.

rules.name: Time Exit Momentum
rules.summary: Buy a 20-bar high and simply leave after ten bars.

rules.name: ATR Stop Long & Short
rules.summary: Trend flips with a 2 ATR stop on every position.

rules.name: Sunday Close To Monday
rules.summary: Hold one day from the Sunday close. A test of a well-known crypto folk rule.

rules.name: Friday To Monday
rules.summary: Hold over the weekend only. Nothing but the calendar decides.

rules.name: Hourly Edge Fade
rules.summary: Short a 60-bar high at market: 3 ATR stop, 2R target. The most stable row of our October study.
